intended_purpose: Industrial telemetry ingestion, local sensor protocol conversion, and cloud MQTT egress

classification.tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)

permitted_routes.notes: Module A cannot be used because harmonised standards are absent, partial, or unverified.

permitted_routes.module: Module B + Module C (EU-Type Examination + Conformity to Type)
permitted_routes.notes: Notified Body examines technical dossier and issues EU-Type Examination Certificate.
Notified Body audits and approves manufacturer quality management system and secure SDLC.

descope_recommendations: VPN De-Scoping: If VPN tunnel is used solely for the device's own telemetry/management, convert to outbound mTLS client session. Remove generic routing/split-tunneling for third-party traffic to avoid Annex III(5) Class I classification.
